This video covers the GTA 6 hype by the numbers: Logitech giving 7,000 employees a paid gaming day off, Australia preparing for a spike in sick leave, IShowSpeed and Kai Cenat streaming GTA 6 before the US release time, and New Zealand getting the game first. We also look at the GTA 6 budget, which analysts estimate at 1 to 2 billion dollars, close to the cost of Burj Khalifa, the 13 year wait since GTA 5, and the GTA 6 price in India with the midnight unlock on PS5 and Xbox Series X. Grand Theft Auto VI from Rockstar Games takes players back to Vice City with Jason and Lucia. Are you playing GTA 6 on launch day?

snippet.title: GTA 6 is the biggest disappointment in gaming history
snippet.description:
GTA 6 review: 2/10 😤 I waited 13 years and I want my money back.

My honest Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA VI) review. No sponsor, no paid promo:

• 30fps only. No 60fps performance mode on PS5
• Chores instead of heists (burgers, mini-golf, dog fetch)
• Jason and Lucia: forgettable characters
• Beautiful world, nothing worth doing in it

Graphics get 2 points. Everything else gets 0. GTA 5 is still more fun for me.

Did GTA 6 live up to the hype for you? Tell me 👇
